description: Mirrors Tax Withholding Account (FRD v3.0, Sheet 8), with one account per side: the TCS Receivable asset for Purchase Invoices and the TCS Payable liability for Sales Invoices.

fields.label: Receivable Account (Purchase)
fields.description: Asset account debited on Purchase Invoices - TCS Receivable. Required when the category is used on purchases.

fields.label: Payable Account (Sales)
fields.description: Liability account credited on Sales Invoices - TCS Payable. Required when the category is used on sales.

name: TCS Account
